desc: Derive and prove the characterization of the minimum number of moves as the minimum total length of two internally vertex-disjoint paths between \(S\) and \(T\).
Analyze the collision constraint and identify the exact impossibility condition.
Develop an efficient min-cost flow algorithm with vertex splitting and successive shortest augmenting paths.
Validate the characterization and implementation against the three samples and relevant edge cases.
Provide the Python implementation that reads stdin and outputs the required integer.
